$comment: Phase 5.3 regulatory change-watch manifest. Seeded from baseline commit 217320f. --check is hermetic; --fetch runs weekly via .github/workflows/regulatory-watch.yml.

watchlist.notes: NIST maintains rev-5 catalog+baselines in the OSCAL-content repo; material changes arrive via new rev (next is Rev. 6), with patch errata a few times a year. Adopted 2026-06-05 (#45): re-fetched fresh (vendor cache deleted first per docs/regulatory-change-watch.md §4.2); manifest SHA 01f37cf9 (rev5 v5.2.0, 1196 controls); nist-sp-800-53-r5.normalised.json regenerated; audit-compliance-mappings PASSED and audit-oscal-roundtrip GREEN; no UC clause remapping required.

CSF 2.0 is the current major; subsequent changes will be profile additions (e.g., quantum). Adopted 2026-06-05 (#45): re-fetched fresh; manifest SHA 4836943f (CSF 2.0 OSCAL build v1.2.0, 219 controls); nist-csf-v2.normalised.json regenerated; audits GREEN.
Paywalled. Next refresh cycle is ~2027 per SC 27 roadmap. Track ISO news page and Annex A reorganisations via published amendments.
PCI SSC ships errata and minor versions on an irregular cadence (typically 1-2x per year). Bookmark the RSS-less Document Library. Grace dates are announced 6-12 months ahead.
EUR-Lex consolidated version. Original regulation text is stable; amendments arrive as separate instruments (e.g., the AI Act's data-protection-related recitals).
HHS/OCR publishes NPRMs and guidance via the HIPAA RSS. The December 2024 NPRM (HIPAA Security Rule update) is the active modernisation track.
Transposition deadline passed October 2024. Track Member-State implementing laws (ENISA tracker) plus Commission implementing acts.
Applied from 17 January 2025. RTS and ITS are the main change-delivery mechanism; track ESAs joint pages.
AICPA ASEC revises TSCs irregularly; most recent substantive revision was 2022. Watch the AICPA Technical Q&A and newsletter.
PCAOB issues staff guidance and proposed standards via their standards page. ITGC-relevant changes are rare but material (e.g., NOCLAR, AS 1000).
DoD CIO hosts the authoritative CMMC 2.0 page. 32 CFR Part 170 was finalised October 2024; DFARS 252.204-7021 rulemaking still in motion.

watchlist.regulationName: UK GDPR (Data Protection Act 2018 + UK GDPR)
watchlist.notes: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 amends the UK GDPR; track legislation.gov.uk plus the ICO's legislative tracker for commencement orders. Adopted 2026-06-05 (#45): Last-Modified advanced to Mon, 01 Jun 2026; header-only flap, no machine-readable artefact to ingest; lastObservedEtag re-stamped, finding cleared.

ATT&CK ships two major releases per year (~April and October) plus point releases; SHA256 tracks the STIX bundle. Adopted 2026-06-05 (#45): enterprise+ics+mobile re-fetched fresh (vendor/attack/*.json deleted first); manifest SHAs fc783039/02c99173/f61e0a1d; same 858 enterprise techniques (errata-level refresh, no IDs added/revoked); all three crosswalks regenerated; simulate_controltest --check and audit-mitre-taxonomy --check GREEN; all 114 controlTest techniques resolve, no UC remapping.
D3FEND releases are irregular; monitor ontology version in the JSON-LD header.
